"Football Training Dream" Season 4 will premiere next week (click here to watch). This season centers on a women's team. Below is the list of new players and some key cast members who will not be returning.

"Football Training Dream" Season 4 new additions: Greyhound Women's Team

Elle magazine published an article today detailing the main new cast additions for "Football Training Dream" Season 4. This is the first public reveal of the new lineup.

Tanya Reynolds may be the most eye-catching new face this season. She plays Alice Chilton, who, along with Lasso and Coach Beard, takes charge of the newly formed Greyhound Women's Team. Below is a brief introduction to her character:

Star players on the new team include:

  • Abby Hearn plays Gemma, whose greatest strength is her ambition
  • Judy Mack plays Boots, a goalkeeper known for her composure and intelligence
  • Fey Marseille plays Lizzie, who is fiercely determined
  • Aisling Sharkey plays Niamh, and alongside Siobhan played by Rex Hayes, the pair are twin sisters who play as defenders

More detailed information and photos of the new cast members can be found in Elle's article.

As in the first three seasons, the team will have a number of additional players, but the show will particularly focus on the five new members listed above, in a format similar to previous seasons where characters like Zhan, Jamie, and Sam were highlighted.

Cast members not returning as regulars: AFC Richmond Men's Team players

"Football Training Dream" Season 4 will not feature many of the characters audiences loved in earlier seasons.

For example, AFC Richmond players Jamie Tartt, Danny Rojas, and Sam Obisanya will not appear as regular cast members in the new season.

They may make surprise cameo appearances in the show, but most of the men's team from seasons one to three will not be seen in season four.

Nick Mohammed, who plays Nate—Lasso's friend turned rival—is expected to return in some form, though not necessarily as a regular cast member.

Core characters such as Ted, Rebecca, Keeley, Roy, and Beard will all return full-time. However, this season they will be working with new faces rather than the familiar old members from earlier seasons.

What are your thoughts on the cast changes in "Football Training Dream" Season 4? Feel free to tell us in the comments section.
